issues.description: The section contains many useful prompt templates but lacks at least one concrete worked example (filled input → example output) to illustrate expected quality and formatting of the generated artefact (e.g., a 1‑page syllabus produced by Prompt 1). Readers may not know the desired level of detail, or how to interpret model output for direct use in a course.
issues.required_fix: Add one short worked example for at least Prompt 1 (Generator sylabu) and ideally one for Prompt 2 (slide deck): show the filled input fields and a concise example of the generated 1‑page syllabus / the 5 slides output. Keep examples realistic and aligned with recommended structure.

issues.description: Wording of the 'Doporučený vizuální pattern slideu' in this section is close but not fully harmonised with the earlier 'Praktická šablona vizuální struktury slideu' from the context memory (which contains explicit constraints such as '3 krátké body nebo krátké vysvětlení + příklad (max. 6 řádků)'). The small differences could lead to inconsistent slide outputs generated by different prompts.
issues.required_fix: Align the visual pattern wording with the canonical phrasing in the guide (include the max length guidance: e.g., '3 krátké body nebo krátké vysvětlení + příklad (max. 6 řádků)') so both prompts and the descriptive note use the same constraints.

issues.description: Several short advisory statements are labelled '(general background knowledge)'. While acceptable as general guidance, the section already cites two KB excerpts (OneNote conversion and Minecraft Education). To improve grounding, cross‑reference the provenance/checklist guidance from the earlier chapters where provenance is explicitly recommended.
issues.required_fix: Add an explicit pointer (or short citation) to the earlier guidance that prescribes what to store for provenance (e.g., 'Ukládejte vždy: vstupní texty, použitý prompt, verze modelu/nástroje a datum vytvoření') so the checklist here matches the recommended practice in the handbook.

issues.description: Prompts for assessment (Prompt 3 and 4) suggest rubrics and milestone checks but do not include a brief example of an automated/automatic or evidence‑based check (e.g., what 'kontrola originality' could practically mean in a milestone context).
issues.required_fix: Add one illustrative suggestion for 'doporučený způsob kontroly originality' per milestone (for example: 'lokální artefakt s časovou razítkovanou editací / commit history in repo / recorded in‑class artefact') and reference the handbook's sections that discuss process‑based verification (sections 5.3–5.4).

issues.description: The section uses multiple verbatim blocks and the \\& escape in the body. While syntactically acceptable in LaTeX, ensure that special characters and backslashes inside verbatim are preserved by the document build pipeline and that the citation keys used (e.g., \cite{kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_04e4a115_page_8_1}) are defined in the bibliography.
issues.required_fix: Verify the LaTeX build: ensure the bibliography includes the cited keys and that verbatim blocks render correctly in the final PDF. If the pipeline strips or reflows verbatim text, convert short verbatim prompts to a minted/listing environment or typewriter font rather than verbatim.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Insert a one‑paragraph worked example: fill the input fields (Název, Úroveň, Počet ECTS, 3–5 cíle, Klíčová témata, Požadavky) and append a 1‑page example syllabus that follows the specified sections. Keep the example concise (2–6 sentences per part) and show the single 'reason for choice' sentence per section.

Rephrase to exactly match the canonical template in the guide: 'hlavička (1 věta), klíčová myšlenka (1–2 věty), 3 krátké body nebo krátké vysvětlení + příklad (max. 6 řádků), dominantní vizuální prvek (1–2 slova) a takeaway/aktivita (1 věta)'. Add an explicit note on per‑slide text limits (e.g., max 6 řádků) to guide model outputs.

Expand item 3 in the quick checklist to list explicit provenance fields to record: 'prompt text, filled input data (or identifiers), model/service name and exact version, generation date/time, prompt author, and output snapshot'. Cross‑reference the handbook guidance where provenance is recommended.

For Prompt 4 and Prompt 3 add one concrete example method for 'doporučený způsob kontroly originality' (e.g., 'commit history in a git repository with timestamps', 'time‑stamped lab notebook/photo of in‑class work', or 'progressive drafts with tracked changes and peer review evidence').

Ensure the two citations used in the section correspond to entries in the document bibliography. If the build system requires numeric keys or different keys, update \cite keys accordingly. Optionally, replace inline '(general background knowledge)' markers with either a short citation to the handbook or remove them if redundant.

retrieval_queries: Example filled input and output for a 1-page syllabus generator prompt (sample from repository or appendix).
Canonical wording of the 'Praktická šablona vizuální struktury slideu' including explicit per‑slide text limits (to ensure exact alignment).
Recommended provenance fields to log for AI‑generated teaching artefacts in the handbook (exact phrasing / checklist item).

Examples of evidence‑based originality checks for milestone‑based assessment used in the guide or appendix (e.g., sample wording for requiring commit histories, time‑stamped artefacts, or in‑class recorded steps).
